notes: Operating case temperature grades: Standard 0 to +70°C (LS-CWxx1G-A2C); Extended -20 to +85°C; Industrial -40 to +85°C (LS-CWxx1G-A2I). temp_min_c/temp_max_c reflect the industrial grade span; adjust per orderable part. Transmitter centre wavelength per channel is λc with λc-6.5 to λc+6.5 nm (λc from ordering wavelength code table). Receiver centre wavelength range 1270 to 1610 nm. Supply current Icc max 300 mA at 3.135–3.465 V (power in W not stated). Receiver sensitivity and overload measured with PRBS 2^7-1 @ 1250 Mbps, BER ≤ 1×10^-12. Optical average output power launched into SMF. Spectral width (-20 dB) Δλ max 1 nm.
provenance_datasheet_sections: 1.25Gbps SFP CWDM Transceiver, Single Mode, 120km Reach
